name: Psychology
overview: Scripture reveals that human understanding and thoughts are limited and often flawed, as God declares His ways and thoughts are higher than ours (Isaiah 55:8). Believers are called to trust in the Lord wholeheartedly rather than rely on their own reasoning (Proverbs 3:5). The condition of the heart deeply affects a person's well-being, but encouragement through godly words brings joy and restoration (Proverbs 12:25). Furthermore, the indwelling Spirit of truth guides believers from within, contrasting with the reprobate mind given to those who reject God (John 14:17; Romans 1:28). Ultimately, fearing God and obeying His commandments is presented as the fundamental duty of humanity, framing the proper orientation of the mind and heart (Ecclesiastes 12:13).
